external_boundaries.content: Authorized read/export request for the selected client and period; the resulting export is stored and mechanically prepared locally, and relevant entries or evidence may enter the selected runtime's model context
controls: Use only a callable provider-specific connector after the user chooses it and confirms access authority.
Restrict the action to read/export for the selected client and period.
Vera and the helper scripts do not request credentials, tokens, cookies, or one-time codes.
external_boundaries.purpose: Acquire an invoice ZIP or folder export when the user chooses connection instead of supplying local support

external_boundaries.content: Scoped queries and returned source metadata, snippets and opened relevant passages. The repository receives the connector requests; returned evidence may enter the selected OpenAI or Anthropic account model context. Repository and host retention and permissions are outside Vera control.
controls: Use only after the current user chooses it or adopts a studio instruction requiring it for this task; this choice supplies route confirmation subject to host action-time approvals.
Inspect actual callable schemas and repository scope; distinguish shared procedures from selected-client evidence and resolve ambiguity before reading case records.
Search and read only. Preserve actual provenance, resolve conflicting versions, treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence, and keep specialist qualification and dedicated mailbox safeguards.
Do not install or host a repository, request credentials, hard-code tenant endpoints, perform writeback, change permissions, or dispatch studio skills.

Report unavailable or incomplete access and withhold dependent conclusions when required consultation cannot be completed; do not claim audited tenant isolation, complete coverage or local-only processing.
external_boundaries.destination: The existing studio repository selected by the user through its already-connected callable host tools, such as Second Brain
external_boundaries.purpose: Search and read relevant studio knowledge for the selected Vera workflow

classes.content: User instructions; the selected Journal Sampling handoff and support batch; and inspection.json. The inspection artifact can expose the first 20 prepared rows from the complete normalized population with prepared-entry and qualification IDs, journal fields and source locators; metadata for every selected PDF including filename, path, support and qualification IDs, capture hash, extractability, text length and error; and one structured record for every parsed FatturaPA document including source name, document type and polarity, invoice number and date, total and currency, supplier and customer names and tax IDs. The complete normalized population is replayed locally for qualification and one-to-one sample closure, the selected support batch is parsed locally in full, and matching is performed only for sampled entries. A professional may direct the selected runtime to open additional exact evidence when structure or sufficiency cannot be resolved; the workflow does not claim that source files are anonymized.
classes.purpose: Understand the prepared sample and selected support batch before deterministic checks

classes.content: Aggregate item-type counts and, for each model-relevant item, an opaque per-run case handle, item type, normalized categorical review status, recommended action and only the names of present mechanical signal classes. Signal values, item titles, names, descriptions, dates, amounts, invoice and movement numbers, tax identifiers, source paths and filenames, prepared-entry and support-artifact IDs, review write targets and complete row objects are excluded. Accepted PDF inventory and non-interpretive artifact items remain available to the human widget but are omitted.
classes.purpose: Let the model select sampled-entry and support cases without receiving the complete review payload

classes.content: At most 25 requested cases per call: populated allowlisted fields such as status, entry date, signed amount, account name, description, beneficiary or counterparty, currency, checks, mismatches, review notes, support type and match signals, professional and assurance status, extracted amount, date or beneficiary, missing-document reason and bounded extracted evidence facts. Physical paths and filenames, prepared-entry and support-artifact IDs, write targets, empty and unmapped fields and duplicate facts are omitted. Exact movement, invoice, account, tax and reference identifiers are represented only as presence facts by default and can be requested for selected cases when exact identity comparison is required. Real names and case facts can remain; opaque handles are routing controls, not anonymization or pseudonymization of the professional case data. Producer-generated document requests can quote exact identifiers, so selected-case model projection also withholds requested_document unless include_exact_identifiers is true. This field gate applies in both data and evidence. The full human review remains unchanged. Mapped descriptions and other selected source text are not automatically anonymized. Recursive projection covers singular and plural technical fields, including JSON-encoded evidence facts. Candidate filenames remain in the private human payload; only candidate_count and the ambiguity status are projected to the model. Enabling exact professional identifiers does not expose technical candidate filenames or receipt IDs. File-backed intake and review payloads are materialized privately before output-directory resolution, parent-bound authorization and fresh read-only assurance replay; explicit paths and sibling-discovered intake use the same checks as inline review requests. Invalid evidence cannot issue a review reference. Embedded Vera MCP assurance and review helpers select the already prepared shared CheckEntries Python runtime through the maintained local activation resolver. Review does not install dependencies. The resolver and workflow children receive the existing allowlisted local-helper environment; resolved interpreter paths remain local technical metadata. An unprepared runtime fails before review persistence.
classes.purpose: Interpret or verify only cases selected from the review index

classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.
classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested

de: Die Inspektion kann Struktur und vollständige Beleginventare offenlegen

Das Modell kann Anweisungen, Stichproben- und Chargenverweise sowie das Inspektionsergebnis lesen: bis zu den ersten 20 Zeilen des normalisierten Bestands mit Buchungsfeldern, vorbereiteten Kennungen und Quellpositionen; für jedes PDF Name, Pfad, Kennungen, Hash, Extrahierbarkeit, Textlänge und Fehler; und für jeden gelesenen FatturaPA-Datensatz Quelle, Typ, Nummer, Datum, Summe, Währung sowie Namen und Steuerkennungen von Lieferant und Kunde. Weitere exakte Nachweise werden nur für eine konkrete Unklarheit geöffnet.
Der Code spielt den gesamten Bestand nach, prüft aber nur die Stichprobe

Der Code reproduziert lokal den vollständigen qualifizierten Bestand, um Integrität und Abschluss zu prüfen, beschränkt ihn eins zu eins auf die Stichprobenzeilen und analysiert vollständig nur die ausgewählte Belegcharge. Zuordnung und Prüfungen gelten ausschließlich für ausgewählte Buchungen; nicht ausgewählte Zeilen gelangen nicht in die Ergebnisse.
Das Modell erhält einen nicht identifizierenden Index; der Berater sieht die Details

Nach den Prüfungen liest der lokale Server die vollständigen Prüfungsdaten. Das Modell erhält Zählwerte und je interpretierbarem Fall nur einen undurchsichtigen Verweis, Typ, Status, vorgeschlagene Aktion und Namen vorhandener Signalklassen; die zufällige Referenz gilt vier Stunden. Werte, Titel, Namen, Beschreibungen, Beträge, Daten, Kennungen und Pfade bleiben aus dem Index heraus. Die Prüfungsansicht behält alle Details für den Berater, ohne sie an das Modell zu senden. Die Vorbereitung begrenzt diese Details auf 1.500 Ergebnisse und 500 PDFs; integrierte Werkzeuge lehnen mehr als 2.500 Elemente oder 2.000.000 Byte ab.
Nur ausgewählte Fälle erreichen das Modell, höchstens 25 pro Aufruf

Jede Antwort ist auf 25 Fälle und 500.000 Byte begrenzt. Sie kann Status, Datum, Beträge, Konto und Beschreibung, Begünstigten oder Gegenpartei, Währung, Prüfungen, Abweichungen, Notizen, Belegtyp und -signale, fachliche Schlussfolgerung, Assurance-Status und extrahierte Nachweise enthalten. Leere oder nicht gemappte Felder, Pfade, Dateinamen, technische Kennungen, Schreibziele und Duplikate bleiben ausgeschlossen; exakte Bewegungs- oder Rechnungsnummern, Konto, Steuerkennungen und Referenzen kommen nur auf Anforderung zum Identitätsvergleich hinzu.
Ein Index und dieselben Grenzen in jeder Variante

Wenn integrierte Werkzeuge verfügbar sind, validieren, speichern und übernehmen sie die Prüfung mit demselben Index und denselben Grenzen. Andernfalls enthält die Übergabe als Markdown oder Datei nur ausgewählte Fälle, und das lokale Studio-Archive-Verfahren bewahrt und finalisiert dieselbe Prüfung, ohne alle vollständigen Prüfungsdaten erneut zu lesen. Eine vollständige Quelle kann für eine konkrete ungeklärte Nachweisfrage geöffnet werden.

Fachdaten werden nicht automatisch anonymisiert oder pseudonymisiert. Undurchsichtige Verweise dienen nur der Fallauswahl: echte Namen, Beschreibungen, Beträge, Daten und Kennungen können das Modell erreichen, wenn die fachliche Prüfung sie benötigt.

Studio Archive grenzt jede Ausführung dieses Prozesses ab und erstellt automatisch einen Bericht über die von Vera gesendeten Daten. Vera erfasst die eigenen Sendungen; der Bericht untersucht weder den Chat noch andere Werkzeuge. Der Bericht bleibt auf dem Rechner, auch wenn alle Daten gesendet wurden. Fehlende Mengenangaben werden ausdrücklich als unbekannt ausgewiesen. Der Server erhält nur den Berichtshash und die Prüfverweise, gebunden an die Vera userID des Rechners, dieselbe Ausführung und Revision. Berichtsinhalte und Nachweise bleiben lokal.
en: Inspection can expose source structure and complete support inventories

The model may read instructions, sample and batch references, and the inspection result: up to the first 20 rows of the normalized population with accounting fields, prepared IDs and source locations; for every PDF, its name, path, IDs, hash, extractability, text length and error; and for every parsed FatturaPA record, source, type, number, date, total, currency, and supplier and customer names and tax IDs. Other exact evidence is opened only for a specific ambiguity.
Code replays the whole population but checks only the sample

Code locally reproduces the complete qualified population to verify integrity and closure, restricts it one-for-one to the sample rows, and fully analyzes only the selected support batch. Matching and checks apply exclusively to sampled entries; unsampled rows do not enter the results.
The model receives a non-identifying index; the professional sees the detail

After checks, the local server reads the complete review data. The model receives counts and, for each interpretable case, only an opaque handle, type, status, proposed action, and names of present signal classes; the random reference lasts four hours. Values, titles, names, descriptions, amounts, dates, identifiers, and paths stay out of the index. The review screen keeps the full detail for the professional without sending it to the model. Preparation limits that detail to 1,500 results and 500 PDFs; integrated tools reject more than 2,500 items or 2,000,000 bytes.
Only selected cases reach the model, at most 25 per call

Each response is limited to 25 cases and 500,000 bytes. It may contain status, date, amounts, account and description, beneficiary or counterparty, currency, checks, mismatches, notes, support type and signals, professional conclusion, assurance status, and extracted evidence. Empty or unmapped fields, paths, filenames, technical IDs, write targets, and duplicates stay out; exact movement or invoice numbers, account, tax IDs, and references arrive only on request for identity comparison.
One index and the same limits in every mode

When available, integrated tools validate, save, and apply the review with the same index and limits. Otherwise, the Markdown or file delivery contains selected cases only, and the local Studio Archive procedure preserves and finalizes the same review without rereading all complete review data. A complete source can be opened for a specific unresolved evidence question.

Professional data is not automatically anonymized or pseudonymized. Opaque references only select cases: real names, descriptions, amounts, dates, and identifiers may reach the model when professional review requires them.

Studio Archive delimits each run of this process and automatically creates a report of the data Vera sent. Vera records its own sends; the report does not inspect the chat or other tools. The report stays on the machine even when all data was sent. Missing counts are explicitly unknown. The server receives only the report hash and verification references, bound to the machine’s Vera userID, the same run and revision. Report contents and evidence remain local.
es: La inspección puede exponer la estructura y los inventarios completos de soportes

El modelo puede leer las instrucciones, las referencias de la muestra y del lote, y el resultado de la inspección: hasta las primeras 20 filas de la población normalizada con campos contables, identificadores preparados y ubicaciones de origen; para cada PDF, nombre, ruta, identificadores, hash, capacidad de extracción, longitud del texto y error; y para cada FatturaPA analizada, origen, tipo, número, fecha, total, moneda, nombres e identificadores fiscales de proveedor y cliente. Solo se abre otra evidencia exacta para una ambigüedad concreta.
El código reproduce toda la población, pero solo comprueba la muestra

El código reproduce localmente toda la población calificada para verificar su integridad y cierre, la restringe uno a uno a las filas de la muestra y analiza por completo solo el lote de soportes seleccionado. Los emparejamientos y controles se aplican exclusivamente a los asientos muestreados; las filas no muestreadas no entran en los resultados.
El modelo recibe un índice no identificativo; el profesional ve el detalle

Después de los controles, el servidor local lee los datos completos de la revisión. El modelo recibe recuentos y, para cada caso interpretable, solo una referencia opaca, tipo, estado, acción propuesta y nombres de las clases de señales presentes; la referencia aleatoria dura cuatro horas. Valores, títulos, nombres, descripciones, importes, fechas, identificadores y rutas quedan fuera del índice. La pantalla de revisión conserva todo el detalle para el profesional sin enviarlo al modelo. La preparación limita ese detalle a 1.500 resultados y 500 PDF; las herramientas integradas rechazan más de 2.500 elementos o 2.000.000 bytes.
Solo los casos elegidos llegan al modelo, como máximo 25 por llamada

Cada respuesta se limita a 25 casos y 500.000 bytes. Puede contener estado, fecha, importes, cuenta y descripción, beneficiario o contraparte, moneda, controles, diferencias, notas, tipo y señales del soporte, conclusión profesional, estado de aseguramiento y evidencias extraídas. Los campos vacíos o no mapeados, rutas, nombres de archivo, identificadores técnicos, destinos de escritura y duplicados quedan fuera; los números exactos de movimiento o factura, cuenta, identificadores fiscales y referencias solo llegan bajo petición para comparar la identidad.
Un mismo índice y los mismos límites en cada modalidad

Cuando están disponibles, las herramientas integradas validan, guardan y aplican la revisión con el mismo índice y los mismos límites. De lo contrario, la entrega en Markdown o en un archivo contiene solo los casos seleccionados y el procedimiento local de Studio Archive conserva y finaliza la misma revisión sin volver a leer todos los datos completos. Puede abrirse una fuente completa para una cuestión probatoria concreta no resuelta.

Los datos profesionales no se anonimizan ni se seudonimizan automáticamente. Las referencias opacas solo sirven para seleccionar casos: nombres, descripciones, importes, fechas e identificadores reales pueden llegar al modelo cuando la revisión profesional los necesita.

Studio Archive delimita cada ejecución de este proceso y crea automáticamente un informe de los datos enviados por Vera. Vera registra sus propios envíos; el informe no inspecciona el chat ni otras herramientas. El informe permanece en el equipo incluso cuando se han enviado todos los datos. Los recuentos que faltan se indican como indeterminados. El servidor recibe únicamente la huella del informe y las referencias de verificación, vinculadas al Vera userID del equipo, a la misma ejecución y revisión. El contenido del informe y las evidencias permanecen locales.
fr: L'inspection peut exposer la structure et les inventaires complets des justificatifs

Le modèle peut lire les instructions, les références de l'échantillon et du lot, ainsi que le résultat de l'inspection : jusqu'aux 20 premières lignes de la population normalisée avec champs comptables, identifiants préparés et emplacements source ; pour chaque PDF, nom, chemin, identifiants, hash, extractibilité, longueur du texte et erreur ; et pour chaque FatturaPA analysée, source, type, numéro, date, total, devise, noms et identifiants fiscaux du fournisseur et du client. Une autre preuve exacte n'est ouverte que pour une ambiguïté précise.
Le code rejoue toute la population mais ne contrôle que l'échantillon

Le code reproduit localement toute la population qualifiée pour en vérifier l'intégrité et la clôture, la restreint ligne par ligne à l'échantillon et analyse intégralement seulement le lot de justificatifs sélectionné. Les rapprochements et contrôles portent exclusivement sur les écritures échantillonnées ; les lignes hors échantillon n'entrent pas dans les résultats.
Le modèle reçoit un index non identifiant ; le professionnel voit le détail

Après les contrôles, le serveur local lit les données complètes de la revue. Le modèle reçoit les décomptes et, pour chaque cas interprétable, uniquement une référence opaque, le type, le statut, l'action proposée et les noms des classes de signaux présentes ; la référence aléatoire dure quatre heures. Valeurs, titres, noms, descriptions, montants, dates, identifiants et chemins restent hors de l'index. L'écran de revue conserve tous les détails pour le professionnel sans les envoyer au modèle. La préparation limite ces détails à 1 500 résultats et 500 PDF ; les outils intégrés refusent plus de 2 500 éléments ou 2 000 000 octets.
Seuls les cas choisis parviennent au modèle, au plus 25 par appel

Chaque réponse est limitée à 25 cas et 500 000 octets. Elle peut contenir statut, date, montants, compte et description, bénéficiaire ou contrepartie, devise, contrôles, écarts, notes, type et signaux du justificatif, conclusion professionnelle, état d'assurance et preuves extraites. Champs vides ou non mappés, chemins, noms de fichiers, identifiants techniques, cibles d'écriture et doublons restent exclus ; numéros exacts de mouvement ou facture, compte, identifiants fiscaux et références n'arrivent que sur demande pour comparer l'identité.
Un même index et les mêmes limites dans chaque mode

Lorsqu'ils sont disponibles, les outils intégrés valident, enregistrent et appliquent la revue avec le même index et les mêmes limites. Sinon, la remise en Markdown ou dans un fichier ne contient que les cas sélectionnés et la procédure locale de Studio Archive conserve et finalise la même revue sans relire toutes les données complètes. Une source complète peut être ouverte pour une question probatoire précise non résolue.

Les données professionnelles ne sont pas automatiquement anonymisées ou pseudonymisées. Les références opaques servent uniquement à sélectionner les cas : noms, descriptions, montants, dates et identifiants réels peuvent parvenir au modèle si la revue professionnelle l'exige.

Studio Archive délimite chaque exécution de ce processus et crée automatiquement un rapport des données envoyées par Vera. Vera enregistre ses propres envois ; le rapport n’inspecte ni la conversation ni les autres outils. Le rapport reste sur la machine même lorsque toutes les données ont été envoyées. Les comptages manquants sont signalés comme indéterminés. Le serveur reçoit uniquement l’empreinte du rapport et les références de vérification, liées au Vera userID de la machine, à la même exécution et à la révision. Le contenu du rapport et les preuves restent locaux.
it: L'ispezione può mostrare struttura e inventari completi dei supporti

Il modello può leggere istruzioni, riferimenti al campione e al lotto e il risultato dell'ispezione: fino alle prime 20 righe della popolazione normalizzata con campi contabili, ID preparati e posizioni sorgente; per tutti i PDF, nome, percorso, ID, hash, estraibilità, lunghezza del testo ed errore; per ogni FatturaPA parsata, origine, tipo, numero, data, totale, valuta, nomi e ID fiscali di fornitore e cliente. Altra evidenza esatta viene aperta solo per un'ambiguità specifica.
Il codice rilegge tutta la popolazione, ma controlla solo il campione

Il codice riproduce localmente l'intera popolazione qualificata per verificarne integrità e chiusura, la restringe uno-a-uno alle righe del campione e analizza integralmente solo il lotto di supporti selezionato. Abbinamenti e controlli riguardano esclusivamente le scritture campionate; le righe non campionate non entrano nei risultati.
Il modello riceve un indice non identificativo; il professionista vede il dettaglio

Dopo i controlli, il server locale legge i dati completi della revisione. Il modello riceve conteggi e, per ogni caso interpretabile, solo riferimento opaco, tipo, stato, azione proposta e nomi dei segnali presenti; la referenza casuale dura quattro ore. Valori, titoli, nomi, descrizioni, importi, date, identificativi e percorsi restano fuori dall'indice. La schermata mostrata al professionista conserva invece tutto il dettaglio, senza inviarlo al modello. La preparazione limita il dettaglio a 1.500 risultati e 500 PDF; gli strumenti integrati rifiutano oltre 2.500 elementi o 2.000.000 byte.
Solo i casi scelti arrivano al modello, al massimo 25 per chiamata

Ogni risposta è limitata a 25 casi e 500.000 byte. Può contenere stato, data, importi, conto e descrizione, beneficiario o controparte, valuta, controlli, differenze, note, tipo e segnali del supporto, conclusione professionale, stato di assurance ed evidenze estratte. Campi vuoti o non mappati, percorsi, nomi file, ID tecnici, destinazioni di scrittura e duplicati restano fuori; numeri di movimento o fattura, conto, ID fiscali e riferimenti esatti arrivano solo su richiesta per il confronto d'identità.
Stesso indice e stessi limiti in ogni modalità

Quando sono disponibili, gli strumenti integrati verificano, salvano e applicano la revisione con lo stesso indice e gli stessi limiti. Altrimenti, la consegna in Markdown o in un file contiene soltanto i casi selezionati e la procedura locale di Studio Archive conserva e finalizza la stessa esecuzione senza rileggere tutti i dati completi della revisione. Una fonte completa può essere aperta per una domanda probatoria specifica rimasta irrisolta.

I dati professionali non vengono anonimizzati né pseudonimizzati automaticamente. I riferimenti opachi servono solo a selezionare i casi: nomi, descrizioni, importi, date e identificativi reali possono arrivare quando sono necessari alla revisione professionale.

Studio Archive delimita ogni esecuzione di questo processo e crea automaticamente un report dei dati inviati da Vera. Vera registra i propri invii; il report non ispeziona la chat o altri strumenti. Il report viene conservato sulla macchina anche quando tutti i dati sono stati inviati. I conteggi mancanti sono indicati come non determinabili. Il server riceve soltanto l’impronta del report e i riferimenti di verifica, associati al Vera userID della macchina, alla stessa esecuzione e alla revisione. Il contenuto del report e le evidenze restano locali.

security_controls.control: The Journal Sampling assurance envelope and normalized receipt are replayed before and after support extraction; every support artifact is captured once and its receipt, bounded parser result, qualification, comparison, numeric ledger, and final assurance replay use the same bytes.

Every product CLI requires a digest-valid running Studio Archive check-entries context, replays its customer-folder manifests and exact selected bytes, accepts support only from that run's receipt-bound execution view, requires the normalized journal, normalization diagnostics, and journal sample to be declared artifacts of one available Journal Sampling run in the same client engagement, and writes only to the exact inspection or checks child of the Check Entries output root.

Before inspection or checking, Check Entries restricts the qualified normalized population to the physical source locators in the exact bound journal_sample.csv artifact; an empty sample, duplicate sample locators, or any sample row that does not close one-for-one to the population fails closed.

A selected support directory is sealed as a complete canonical relative-path manifest; added, removed, replaced, Unicode/case aliases, temporary-prefixed files, symbolic links, hard-link aliases, and special filesystem entries fail closed.

Party, support-relationship, currency, and direction exceptions are accepted only as reviewed-decision receipts bound to the exact normalized journal, prepared entry, support artifact and locator; free-text names or amount/date coincidence cannot promote a result.

MCP validation can load review_payload.json inside the local server and returns only a non-identifying index plus a random four-hour reference. Rendering exposes the complete digest-valid payload only in tool-result _meta, which is component-only, while model-visible content and structuredContent contain the index. The widget hydrates from toolResponseMetadata and retains the complete human review surface.

The read-only case-context tool accepts only opaque handles bound to the current in-memory review reference, rejects unknown or duplicate handles, limits each call to 25 cases and 500000 response bytes, projects explicit post-mapping field allowlists, recursively strips physical and technical identifiers from evidence facts, and keeps exact professional identifiers off unless explicitly requested for those selected cases.

MCP save and apply capture the bounded canonical output tree and modes in parent-process memory, execute workflow helpers only against a detached working tree, reject linked, aliased, special, oversized, swapped, or unexpected entries, and restore exact trusted bytes and modes if revision, workbook, assurance, manifest, trace, or commit validation fails.

Inside the transaction, the MCP parent derives run, review, current UI, final state, decisions, effects, paths, gates, readiness, and professional status from the trusted persisted image; supplied copies must match exactly, helper JSON is acknowledgement-only, and every source, run, implementation, review, audit, envelope, and current-output binding is replayed before commit.

Workflow-child startup, nonzero exit, oversized, empty, malformed, wrongly typed, and contradictory status-zero results fail with bounded fixed messages; child stdout, traceback text, absolute client paths, and unvalidated result fields are not copied into the MCP response or execution trace.

Run, validate, render, save and apply enforce the same workflow-owned physical file and directory perimeter for the initial package, bounded review transition and accepted successor; foreign files, links, hardlink aliases, special entries and post-preflight swaps fail closed, and late failures restore the exact prior tree.

Python entrypoints redirect bytecode lookup and disable bytecode writes before validating and loading the declared source implementation. Cache directories and regular bytecode files are excluded from the source receipt set; they are not treated as executable authority. Optional explicit repair removes only ordinary single-link .pyc files directly inside cache folders under this component own vendor tree, without traversing symlinks or falling back to shared vendor roots. This local maintenance path does not add model calls or external destinations.

The local review server requires the session token for output downloads. It accepts only files declared by the local run, within its output directory, rejects symlinks and traversal, and limits downloads to 50 MB. Files are downloaded as opaque bytes; HTML is not executed in the review origin. This does not claim atomic protection from concurrent filesystem changes. The browser may retain a user-requested downloaded copy; this route does not send document content to the model or an external service.

Explicit CLI amount tolerance and date window override the corresponding captured recipe checks, including zero; omitted flags use recipe values and only absent values default to zero. Invalid types or negative values stop with transactional rollback. The audit and intake retain effective values while execution_recipe preserves exact original recipe bytes. Intake currency comes from the exact checked entries, never output language or a fixed EUR default; mixed/unknown currency has no invented single value. Fresh material replay compares intake assumptions and results.

PDF identity accepts the explicit Italian accounting label Registrazione contabile, optionally with a number label, only beside the exact distinctive movement identifier. It does not infer identity from filenames, generic numeric references, amount/date coincidence or intervening unrelated words; party, direction, relationship and professional gates remain unchanged.

Complete upstream journals may include explicit zero-valued postings. They do not invalidate source replay or the population used to validate a bound sample; the existing source, amount, identity, relationship and support checks remain enforced. No new model call or external destination is introduced.
